contract.road_stock_integration: Trapezoid over complete 30s observation grid; absent sparse positive rows are zero only at known observed timestamps.
contract.speed: Vehicle-weighted mean over positive-count snapshots; empty cells masked, never counted as stopped congestion.
contract.connector_events: Existing analyze_ramp_corridor.scan: ID departure from connector to any observed other link; unique direct source→target connector skips reported separately. Interior disappearance is not departure.
contract.connector_blocks: Existing 150s destination-observation timestamp bins [start,end); first and final censored blocks excluded. Event intervals touching a decision boundary retain up to one recording-step alignment uncertainty.
contract.spillback: Report physical connector stopped stock and simultaneous upstream road/cell queues. This association does not establish a continuous queue tail or causal spillback by itself.
contract.upstream_propagation: First sustained slow onset of cell i compared with downstream i+1; positive lag is temporal ordering, not identified causal shockwave speed.
contract.actuation: Actual action CSV against existing oracle plus complete one-second SG/ramp cadence; only the documented pair of identical immediate ramp rows at interval start is allowed. VSL requires both finite vehicle-class DSD readbacks and is not vehicle speed compliance.
contract.omega: Existing measure_control_area, native FZP-only phase. TTT is union stock residence; observed exits and terminal inference separate; internal disappearance never rewarded.

execution.scope: Necessary execution check; command readback and experimental comparability require separate review.

actuation.reason: Native NC has no area MPC scoring contract.

area_metrics.precision: sampled; boundary transitions observed, terminal departures inferred
area_metrics.ttt_integration_rule: trapezoid in actual timestamp space; left/right are integration choices, not statistical confidence bounds

closure.equation: N_after-N_before = observed_entry + appeared_inside - observed_exit - terminal_inferred - unresolved_inside_disappearance
closure.warning: This closes the sampled bookkeeping, not a proof that every between-sample physical crossing was observed.

terminal_inference.rule: absent next frame, last on verified terminal, reachable endpoint or bounded one-simulation-step position overshoot; no TMINNETTOT assumption

limitations: An inside→outside→inside excursion completed between snapshots is not observed.
First appearances inside may be admitted vehicles or missed entrance transitions; reported separately.
Removal near a terminal is indistinguishable from normal departure with sampled records; terminal inference is separately reported.
The final observed vehicles are censored, never counted as exits just because the file ended.
No route inference is performed for skipped short connectors.
area_metrics.observation_phase: native FZP only; vehicles present in the final record remain censored, including endpoint overshoots

connector_metadata.definition: Vehicle-ID source/connector/target transitions; short connector skips separately tagged
connector_metadata.limitation: 5-second snapshots may miss multi-link passages; no interior disappearances counted; first/final blocks censored

area_window.event_timing: Canonical event rows whose destination timestamp is in (start,end]; crossing within its recording interval is not known exactly.

focus.queue_definition: SPEED<5km/h; min/max stopped vehicle front positions by physical connector lane. This occupied extent does not prove a continuous queue or its cause.
focus.event_definition: Existing probe_e8_window_passages.transitions/event_summary: observed versus unique skipped connector events, interval brackets and estimated counts remain separate.
